skills.name: Tough
skills.description: More hit points.

skills.name: Light Step
skills.description: Moves one square farther.

skills.name: Sure Footing
skills.description: Rough ground never costs more than one step.

skills.name: Slip Through
skills.description: Can move through enemy units.

skills.name: Strike and Move
skills.description: After acting, can still move with the movement it has left.

skills.name: Fast Learner
skills.description: Gains experience faster.

skills.name: Gifted
skills.description: Grows faster in four stats.

skills.name: Opening Blow
skills.description: Hits harder when it starts the fight.

skills.name: Hold the Line
skills.description: Takes less damage when defending.

skills.name: Back to the Wall
skills.description: Critical chance up at half HP or less.

skills.name: On My Own
skills.description: Fights better with no ally nearby.

skills.name: Close Fighter
skills.description: Harder to hit in close combat.

skills.name: Steady Aim
skills.description: Hits more often from a distance.

skills.name: Beat Them to It
skills.description: When defending at half HP or less, strikes first.

skills.name: Double Strike
skills.description: Each strike is made twice when it starts the fight.

skills.name: Always Ready
skills.description: Counterattacks from any distance.

skills.name: Clean Hit
skills.description: At full HP, the foe cannot counterattack when it starts the fight.

skills.name: Braced
skills.description: When defending, the foe strikes one time fewer.

skills.name: Rallying Presence
skills.description: Allies nearby hit and avoid more.

skills.name: Unnerving Presence
skills.description: Enemies nearby are easier to hit.

skills.name: Heavy Blow
skills.description: A chance to deal double damage.

skills.name: Draining Blow
skills.description: A chance to heal by half of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Extra Swing
skills.description: A chance to strike once more.

skills.name: Glancing Hit
skills.description: A chance to take half damage.

skills.name: Hang On
skills.description: At half HP or more, survives a deadly strike with 1 HP.

skills.name: Second Charge
skills.description: After defeating a foe it started fighting, can move and act again.

skills.name: Catch Breath
skills.description: Heals a quarter of its HP after defeating a foe.

skills.name: Parting Jab
skills.description: After starting a fight, hurts the foe a little.

skills.name: Steady Recovery
skills.description: Heals a tenth of its HP at the start of its turn.

skills.name: Caring Presence
skills.description: Heals allies next to it at the start of its turn.
